$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. LoopCompatibilityReport per docs/ratified/loops/LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §1-§11 (FB-RAT-CMP-001..007). Ten axes (§2, FB-RAT-CMP-001) each resolve to one of five outcomes (§3, FB-RAT-CMP-004); overall outcome is the worst axis outcome under §3's strict precedence order (UNSUPPORTED > BLOCKED > DEGRADED > COMPATIBLE_WITH_BINDINGS > COMPATIBLE) — encoded structurally below via allOf/if/then/contains, not left as prose alone. `phoneAuthoritative` is pinned `const: true` (§6, FB-RAT-CMP-005): this schema has no representable shape for a marketplace- or browser-produced report, because §6 requires those be labeled a 'preview against a declared profile' and MUST NOT be cached or reused as if authoritative — a genuinely different, unmodeled object, not a false value of this field.
title: LoopCompatibilityReport
description: The phone-authoritative evaluation of whether a specific installing phone can understand, install, bind, and run a specific LoopPackage release, across all ten compatibility axes, without hiding degradation or silently substituting an unsafe resource (LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §1). Produced by the PARSED_VALIDATED-to-COMPATIBILITY_EVALUATED transition (LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §3) and re-run whenever the §10 cache key changes or a destructive/publish-class execution is about to start.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this report's shape. A reader MUST reject an unrecognized MAJOR (FB-RAT-COM-003).

reportId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this report (FB-RAT-COM-002).

packageDigest.description: packageContentDigest of the release being evaluated (floop-container-format.v1.json).

phoneAuthoritative.description: FB-RAT-CMP-005: the installing phone MUST be the sole authoritative evaluator. See this schema's top-level $comment for why there is no false-value counterpart object in this schema — a non-authoritative preview is a different, unmodeled shape, per LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §6.

axisOutcomes.description: Exactly the ten axes LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §2 (FB-RAT-CMP-001) requires — no fewer, and (via minItems=maxItems=10 combined with the ten `contains` clauses, each requiring a distinct axis value present) no duplicates or omissions either: ten required-distinct values in an array capped at length 10 forces exactly one entry per axis.

overallOutcome.description: Derived from the worst per-axis outcome under §3's strict precedence order — structurally enforced by the `allOf` below, not merely documented.

cacheKey.description: LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §10's exact six-field cache key tuple. A cached report MUST NOT be reused once any one of these six fields changes on the installing phone (§10's CACHED_VALID-to-CACHED_STALE transition), and MUST be re-evaluated regardless of cache validity immediately before any EXECUTE_DESTRUCTIVE-or-above or PUBLISH_OR_RELEASE-class execution (§10's MUST_REVALIDATE row).

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

allOf.$comment: §3 precedence 1 (highest): any UNSUPPORTED axis finding forces overall UNSUPPORTED, regardless of what else is present.
§3 precedence 2: BLOCKED wins only in the absence of a higher-precedence UNSUPPORTED finding.

CompatibilityOutcome.description: LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §3's five-value outcome enum (FB-RAT-CMP-004), in descending recoverability / ascending severity as listed: COMPATIBLE, COMPATIBLE_WITH_BINDINGS, DEGRADED, BLOCKED, UNSUPPORTED. FB-RAT-IMP-007 (owned by LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md) consumes this exact enum for its COMPATIBILITY_EVALUATED transition.

code.description: A rule code from loop-validation-rules.v1.json — for compatibility findings, typically the LOOP-COMPAT namespace (e.g. LOOP-COMPAT-001, LOOP-COMPAT-002), though any namespace's code MAY appear here when an axis's finding is grounded in a non-LOOP-COMPAT rule.

outcome.description: FB-RAT-IMP-007: this axis's own outcome, one of the same five values `overallOutcome` draws from.

reason.description: Actionable reason text for this axis's outcome (LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §1 — 'without hiding degradation'). MUST NOT be empty even when `outcome` is COMPATIBLE — state plainly what was checked and that it passed, not just omit reasoning for the passing case.

remediationType.description: §11's closed remediation action, required whenever `outcome` is not COMPATIBLE (see the `if`/`then` below) — a non-compatible axis outcome with no remediation path leaves the user stuck with no next step, which §11 exists to prevent.

allOf.$comment: LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §11: any non-COMPATIBLE axis outcome MUST carry a remediationType (non-null) — an unresolvable finding with no path forward is still ABANDON_IMPORT, never a silent absence.

capabilityInventoryDigest.description: Digest over the installing phone's currently-installed capability inventory.

policyDigest.description: Digest over the principal's currently-held policy/grant state (CAPABILITY_AUTHORITY_MODEL.md).

deviceOsProfile.description: A stable, non-personally-identifying device/OS classification string — MUST NOT be a value capable of re-identifying one specific physical unit (LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §8's same DeviceIdentity.family/board-not-usbDescriptor discipline applies here by the same reasoning).

distributionFlavor.description: DISTRIBUTION_CAPABILITY_SPLIT.md's `dist` Gradle dimension flavor names (FB-RAT-DIST-001), lowercase to match the flavor's own wire vocabulary rather than this corpus's usual SCREAMING_SNAKE convention.
